name: Zinnia, Valley's Voice, Sword of the Squeak — counting creatures with base power (or toughness) 1
notes: Found while fixing Bess (project_bess_base_pt_and_amount_in_subject_2026-10-14). 'The number of other creatures you control with base power 1' and 'for each creature you control with base power or toughness 1' counted 0: the '[qualifiers] [type]' block of _computeForEachCount read 'with <keyword>' only. It now reads 'with base …' through _parseBasePTQualifier (cards-text-utils.js), the helper subject filters use. Memnite has a +1/+1 counter and still has base 1/1; Goblin Piker (2/1) has base toughness 1; Grizzly Bears (2/2) and the opponent's Fugitive Wizard count for neither. Zinnia (1/3) counts Elves and Memnite, not itself: 3/3. The Sword on Grizzly Bears counts Elves, Memnite, Goblin Piker and Zinnia: +4/+4, 6/6. Memory: project_zinnia_sword_count_base_power_2026-10-14.
